title: Triple Goddess Eclipse
description: Three identical female profiles with closed eyes and long flowing green hair are positioned side by side, merging into a swirling green form. A large pink moon glows above them while a radiant golden sun emits beams of light on the right, set against a dark cracked stone background with orange glowing embers.
prompt: Three serene female profiles with closed eyes and long, vibrant green flowing hair that drips and merges together, positioned centrally. A glowing pink moon floats above them and a bright golden sun with radiating beams sits to the right. Dark cracked stone ruins form the background with subtle orange embers at the bottom, mystical surreal fantasy style, rich textures and luminous celestial lighting.
